# Great partnerships begin with chemistry

## Chemtrade

Like elements acting in **partnership** to create the **chemical products** we sell, Chemtrade is
strengthened by the many people, groups and organizations we are fortunate to call partners.

We are driven by a clear Vision: **create value through responsible chemistry**. The three pillars
of Chemtrade’s Values – Safety, Excellence, and Partnership – shape everything we do, empowering our
people to serve customers with quality products and services across North America and around the
world.

Chemtrade is connections.

## Chemical Products

We operate in two strategic business segments, each featuring a lineup of high-quality industrial
chemical products.

### Sulphur & Water Chemicals (SWC)

[READ MORE][91]

### Electrochemicals (EC)

[READ MORE][92]

## Product Applications

Chemtrade products are used in a wide range of industries and applications.

* [product application banner] *

### Industries we serve include:

Water and Wastewater Treatment, Food, Beverage, Pulp & Paper, Oil & Gas, Industrial Processing,
Agriculture, and more.

[Read More][93]

## Environmental, Social & Governance

* [Responsible care img in Environmental, Social & Governance] *

### A promise to the planet

Chemtrade is committed to doing business in a responsible manner. Sustainability and safety are core
values woven into every aspect of our business from manufacturing to shipping, employee training,
and more. The commitment we make to offering a safe workplace and operating in a sustainable manner
extends through every level of our company.

Responsible Care®, the chemical industry’s voluntary, comprehensive initiative in safe, responsible,
and sustainable chemical manufacturing, is the heart of Chemtrade’s commitment to Environmental,
Social & Governance practices. It is a key element of our partnerships with the people who work
here, the customers and suppliers we do business with, and the communities we operate in.

Find out more about Chemtrade’s Commitment to [Environmental, Social & Governance practices and
Responsible Care®.][94]

TSX: CHE.UN

# Great partnerships begin with chemistry

## Chemtrade

Like elements acting in **partnership** to create the **chemical products** we sell, Chemtrade is
strengthened by the many people, groups and organizations we are fortunate to call partners.

We are driven by a clear Vision: **create value through responsible chemistry**. The three pillars
of Chemtrade’s Values – Safety, Excellence, and Partnership – shape everything we do, empowering our
people to serve customers with quality products and services across North America and around the
world.

Chemtrade is connections.

## Chemical Products

We operate in two strategic business segments, each featuring a lineup of high-quality industrial
chemical products.

Agriculture, and more.

## Environmental, Social & Governance

* [Responsible care img in Environmental, Social & Governance] *

### A promise to the planet

Chemtrade is committed to doing business in a responsible manner. Sustainability and safety are core
values woven into every aspect of our business from manufacturing to shipping, employee training,
and more. The commitment we make to offering a safe workplace and operating in a sustainable manner
extends through every level of our company.

Responsible Care®, the chemical industry’s voluntary, comprehensive initiative in safe, responsible,
and sustainable chemical manufacturing, is the heart of Chemtrade’s commitment to Environmental,
Social & Governance practices. It is a key element of our partnerships with the people who work
here, the customers and suppliers we do business with, and the communities we operate in.

Find out more about Chemtrade’s Commitment to [Environmental, Social & Governance practices and
Responsible Care®.][94]

## The Leader In Water And Wastewater Disinfection And Treatment

At SUPERIOR™, we don’t just manufacture gas and liquid feed systems, we set the industry standard.
Our SUPERIOR™ Gas Chlorinators, VacuFeed Liquid Chemical Feed Systems, and cutting-edge
instrumentation are the most technologically advanced products on the market. When you choose
SUPERIOR™, you’re not just purchasing a system, you’re investing in a commitment to quality,
innovation, and unmatched customer support.


Crafted from high-quality, corrosion-resistant materials, our chlorinators are designed for
durability and long-term performance. Whether you're looking for a complete system or replacement
parts, every component is precision-engineered to ensure seamless compatibility and trouble-free
operation. Our systems are built to last, requiring minimal maintenance while delivering consistent
and reliable results.

What truly sets us apart is our dedication to customer satisfaction. We don’t just sell products we
support them for life. Our team at Chemical Injection Technologies, Inc. is committed to keeping
SUPERIOR™ at the forefront of technology, ensuring you always have access to the highest quality in
design and materials. When you need assistance, we are just a phone call away, no voicemails, no
automated systems, just real people ready to help. We understand that reliability is everything when
it comes to water treatment. That’s why we back our products with comprehensive warranties and
provide live customer support to answer your questions, troubleshoot concerns, and ensure your
system operates flawlessly. With SUPERIOR™, you’re never alone we stand behind every product, every
step of the way.

# We Simplify Water

H2O Innovation is a water solutions company dedicated to helping communities and industries solve
their most pressing water challenges. Guided by its mission to Simplify Water, the Corporation
delivers value through five synergistic pillars: Water Technologies & Services (WTS), Specialty
Products (SP), Operation & Maintenance (O&M), Water Infrastructure Development (WID), and Maple &
Agri-food (MAF). H2O Innovation provides equipment, chemicals, consumables, and long-term services
that support the full life cycle of water, wastewater, and water reuse. Every day, the Corporation
empowers its team with the resources and guidance they need to exceed customer expectations. By
integrating innovation and operational excellence, H2O Innovation has become a trusted global
partner for sustainable water management.

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

***Hawkins Has Been Serving Customers For Over 85 Years.  ***

***We Have A Dedicated Team Ready To Help You With All Your Chemical, Ingredient, And Service
Needs.***

# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the
CDMO industry, setting the pace with cutting-edge science, smart technology, and lean manufacturing.
United by a common purpose, we turn our customers’ breakthrough innovations into viable therapies
and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Founded in Switzerland in 1897, our company is the first and original CDMO. Today, we bring together
a team of 20,000 colleagues across five continents to deliver integrated offerings that meet the
complex needs of our global customer community.

# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the
CDMO industry, setting the pace with cutting-edge science, smart technology, and lean manufacturing.
United by a common purpose, we turn our customers’ breakthrough innovations into viable therapies
and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Founded in Switzerland in 1897, our company is the first and original CDMO. Today, we bring together
a team of 20,000 colleagues across five continents to deliver integrated offerings that meet the
complex needs of our global customer community.

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]
* [ [Electrical]Electrical & Electronics ][172]
* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

**Dual Sanitizer:** Slowly releases both bromine and chlorine for steady, balanced disinfection.

**Performs In High PH:** Bromine remains effective up to pH 8.2, unlike chlorine alone.
**Gentler Use:** Less odor and irritation, bromamines remain effective unlike chloramines.
**Low-Maintenance: **Slow-dissolving, reducing chemical additions and easing upkeep.

**Strong Disinfectant: **Eliminates bacteria, viruses, and algae for clean, safe pool water.
**High Chlorine Content:** 65–70% available chlorine delivers strong results with low dosage.
**Residual Protection:** Provides long-lasting chlorine to prevent regrowth between treatments.
**Easy Handling:** Solid granules or tablets are safer and more stable than liquid chlorine.
**PH Impact: **Alkaline (pH 10–11), requiring adjustment and may raise calcium hardness.
**Shock Treatment: **Excellent for super-chlorination, removing odors and restoring clarity.

**Dual Sanitizer:** Slowly releases both bromine and chlorine for steady, balanced disinfection.
**Broad-Spectrum Control: **Effective against bacteria, viruses, algae, and fungi.
**Performs In High PH:** Bromine remains effective up to pH 8.2, unlike chlorine alone.
**Gentler Use:** Less odor and irritation, bromamines remain effective unlike chloramines.
**Low-Maintenance: **Slow-dissolving, reducing chemical additions and easing upkeep.

### Calcium Hypochlorite - Overview

****Calcium hypochlorite ****is a chemical compound with the chemical formula of Ca(ClO)2. Calciums
hypochlorite is widely used for a water treatment and bleaching agent. Different grades of calcium
are available depends upon its applications in different industries.

Our Products is Associate in Nursing compound with formula Ca(ClO)2. it’s the most active ingredient
of business product referred to as whitener, halogen powder, or chloride of lime, used for water
treatment and as a bleaching agents. This compound is comparatively stable and has larger accessible
halogen than bleaching agent (liquid bleach). it’s a white solid, though industrial samples seem
yellow. It powerfully smells of halogen, because of its slow decomposition in dampish air. it’s not
extremely soluble in H2O, and is a lot of ideally utilized in soft to medium-hard water. it’s 2
forms: dry (anhydrous); and hydrous (hydrous).

[ More Information ][26]
[Calcium Hypochlorite]

### Product Applications

Calcium hypochlorite is also proven powerful germicide and biocide capable of killing harmful
pathogenic like bacteria, algae and fungus. Calcium hypochlorite is used as reacting agent for the
manufacture of chloroform and bleaching powders and it used as a sanitizing food and beverage
products for hospital purposes. Our Products is utilized as an important feedstock in the production
of chloroform and is an effective alternative chlorination for water supplies in an emergency
situations

# CAVITAS-M — Кавитационная обработка воды для сельского хозяйства

[Принцип работы][1] [Устройство][2] [Вопросы и ответы][3] [Связаться][4]

## Инновации для вашего урожая

CAVITAS-M производит устройства для ферм и теплиц в зонах рискованного земледелия. Повышайте
урожайность овощных и других культур на 15–24% за счёт кавитационной обработки поливной воды — без
химических удобрений.

13 лет опыта в сфере водоподготовки. Патент Республики Казахстан №9145. Патент Турции TR 2025
001116U5.

Телефон / WhatsApp: [+7 (777) 285-59-47][5]

Email: [k19582103@gmail.com][6]

## Как это работает?

CAVITAS-M использует метод физической кавитации. Вода обрабатывается микропузырьками, которые
изменяют её структуру, делая биологически активной.

### Обработка воды

Система очищает и подготавливает воду на молекулярном уровне, удаляя вредные примеси.

### Улучшенное усвоение

Растения впитывают биологически активную воду быстрее и с меньшими затратами энергии.

### Высокая урожайность

Увеличение количества и качества плодов без необходимости использовать химикаты.

## Устройство M6-1V001A — Новейшая модификация 2025

Инновационное устройство CAVITAS-M предназначено для обработки поливной воды и производства
экологически чистой продукции без применения химических удобрений.

Оно оптимизирует работу корневой системы и ускоряет рост. Компактные размеры позволяют легко
интегрировать систему в существующие узлы водоснабжения, а прочный корпус из нержавеющей стали
гарантирует долгий срок службы.
* Расход воды: 1000 л/ч
* Давление: до 5 бар
* Энергопотребление: 0.12–50 Вт·ч
* Прибавка к урожаю: 15–24%

[Устройство CAVITAS-M M6-1V001A для кавитационной обработки поливной воды]

## Часто задаваемые вопросы

### Что делает устройство CAVITAS-M?

Микроэлементы становятся биологически активными и лучше усваиваются растениями, увеличивая
урожайность без использования реагентов или удобрений.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

serving the unique needs of distributors in the Caribbean. With a commitment to delivering
high-quality products at competitive prices, we specialize in innovative and effective water care

processes, resort pools, desalination plants, marine operations, and more.

At Crystalline Distribution, we believe that clean water is essential for healthy communities and
thriving industries.

#### Sanitizers

Chlorine tablets are a widely used pool disinfectant,renowned for their effectiveness in killing
bacteria,algae,and clarifying water.

][126]
[Chlorine Stabilizer]

### [Chlorine Stabilizer][127]

[

#### Chlorine Stabilizer

Chlorine stabilizer has strong bactericidal power,low odor and good stability. It can effectively
kill all kinds of bacteria in the pool,without residue,without polluting the environment,and can
keep the pool water clear.

][128]
[Flocculants]

### [Flocculants][129]

[

#### Flocculants

Flocculants help remove suspended particles and impurities from industrial wastewater or drinking
water by promoting the coagulation of fine particles into larger,more easily removable flocs.

][130]
[pH Adjusters]

### [pH Adjusters][131]

[

#### pH Adjusters

pH adjusters are chemicals used to regulate the pH levels of water,ensuring it falls within the
desired range for specific applications.

][132]

Food preservatives meet safety standards. They extend the shelf life of food by inhibiting the
growth of microorganisms such as bacteria,yeast and mold.

][134]

Essential for accurate assessment and monitoring of water quality parameters. Ensure precision in
maintaining optimal conditions for various applications.

][136]

### [[Becoming a Distributor]][60]

### About Us

Dioxide Pacific is a multi-disciplinary engineering company specializing in the manufacture of
electrolysis chlorine dioxide and chlorine generators; chemical dosing, water treatment and water
disinfection systems.

Our product range includes our own manufactured [Electricide^{®} chlorine dioxide generators][61];
[2-chemical][62] and [3-chemical][63] chlorine dioxide generators; [chlorine dioxide NOX destruction
systems][64]; [electrolytic chlorine generators][65] and [O3Pure ozone bottled water disinfection
systems][66]; [Fristam][67] stainless steel hygienic centrifugal pumps; [Atlantium][68] medium
pressure UV; [Glasco][69] low pressure UV; [ProMinent ][70]chemical dosing and monitoring equipment;
[Fiberstrut][71] non-metallic channel and fasteners.

Our systems include [chlorine][72]; [chlorine dioxide][73]; [ozone][74]; [UV][75]; [chemical
dosing][76] [skids][77] and [building mount][78] plant.

Our organization includes design engineers, sales staff and [distributors][79].

### Our Vision

We were established in 1997, with the aim of streamlining the process of taking a water
disinfection, water treatment or chemical dosing project from inception to completion. Through our
strategic partnership with [Paul Grover & Associates][80], we are able to design and manufacture a
system to your requirements.

Synergising the expertise of our Chemical Engineers and associate consultants, we focus on
development of niche chemical generation systems to meet the needs of water disinfection and
chemical oxidation applications. Our manufactured products are the result of R&D investment and
include cutting-edge technology for control, data management and remote connectivity.

# Home Page

Marine Deck Maintenance Ship Hold Tank Cleaning Rigs & Oilfield Water Treatment

### Featured Marine Chemicals

#### Oil Spill Dispersant

Rapid-action dispersant that breaks down oil slicks into biodegradable microdroplets for safer,
faster marine and industrial cleanup.

#### Air Cooler Cleaning Chemical

Specially formulated cleaner that removes scale, dust, and microbial buildup to enhance air cooler
efficiency and airflow.

#### Vapor Treatment

High-performance volatile corrosion inhibitor that protects metal surfaces in closed steam and vapor
systems.

#### Rust Stain Remover

Quickly eliminates stubborn rust stains from decks, hulls, and painted surfaces without abrasion or
corrosion.

#### Descaling Liquid

Effectively removes lime and scale deposits from boilers and coolers.

#### Heavy Duty Degreaser

Heavy-duty marine degreaser engineered to dissolve tough grease, oil, and sludge from engine rooms,
bilges, and industrial surfaces.

### Featured Ship Hold & Tank Cleaning

#### Slip Barrier Coat

Polymer based product, forms a protective, non-stick barrier on cargo holds to prevent material
adhesion and ease post-discharge cleaning.

#### RX Tuff High Foam

High Foam, higher power - designed for hold cleaning and general degreasing.

#### Lime Remover HD

Innovative, concentrated liquid product specifically engineered to attack, penetrate and remove lime
deposit accumulations from cargo and storage tanks.

#### RXSOL PCS Hold Clean

Effectively removes, Coal Carbon, pet coke and mineral & lime deposits from cargo holds and tanks.

#### Alkaline Safety Liquid

Non-caustic alkaline cleaner formulated to remove vegetable oils, animal fats, hydrocarbons, lube
oils, and petcoke residues from cargo tanks.

#### Iron Ore Cargo Clean

Concentrated blend of RXSOL proprietory formulated various products, which is specifically designed
for the rapid removal of rust, while providing phosphatized ferrous metal surface.

### Featured Rigs & Oilfield Chemicals

#### RXSOL RIG WASH

Emulsifier with powerful penetrating agents, corrosion inhibitors and surfactants. Quickly removes
oil, grease, gimres - best for cleaning double bottom tanks

#### Corrosion Inhibitor for Oil Pipeline

A highly effective, film-forming corrosion control agent specifically designed for oil and gas
production and transmission systems operating under sour gas (H2S) and acid gas (CO2) conditions.

#### Crude Oil Defoamer

Defoamer designed to effectively control foam in crude oil processing and refinery operations.

#### H2S Scavenger

Wide range of Hydrogen Sulfide Scavenger to elimiate traces of H2S fouling.

#### Scale Inhibitor

Specially designed to inhibit the scale formation in polyamide-, celluloseacetate- and
polyethermembranes with anionically charged surface.

#### Flocculants

Specialized well oil flocculant that aggregates suspended oils and solids for improved separation
and wastewater clarity.

### Featured Water Treatment Chemicals

#### Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors

Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors for cooling towers - multi metal protection, as well as for boiler
treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

#### One Shot Treatment

Use one shot powder/liquid treatment for your cooling/boiler unit which contains - corrosion/scale
inhibitor, alkalinity booster, oxygen scavenger, etc.

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and

### Standards

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

## CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE

### What Is Calcium Hypochlorite?

### HISTORY OF CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE

### What Is Calcium Hypochlorite?

Calcium hypochlorite is well-known as one type of disinfectant. Calcium hypochlorite is commonly
used to sanitize public swimming pools and disinfect drinking water. Calcium hypochlorite destroys
germs that are capable of causing health problems. Like diarrhea and various respiratory, skin and
wound infections. Generally the commercial calcium hypochlorite is sold with our purity of 70% to
73%. It’s including other chemicals, such as calcium chloride and calcium carbonate as present
production process.

Calcium [hypochlorite][2] is a white solid that contains 65% available chlorine and dissolves easily
in water. Calcium hypochlorite is very stable and can be stored for an extended period of time.
Calcium hypochlorite is a corrosive material with a strong odor. Reactions between calcium
hypochlorite and organic material can generate enough heat to cause a fire or explosion. It must be
kept away from organic materials such as wood, cloth, and [petroleum products][3]. Calcium
hypochlorite readily absorbs moisture, forming [chlorine gas][4].

Calcium hypochlorite can be dissolved in a mixing/holding tank and injected in the same manner as
[sodium hypochlorite][5]. Alternatively, where the pressure can be lowered to atmospheric, such as
at a storage tank, tablets of calcium hypochlorite can be directly dissolved in the free flowing
water.



### Sodium Process

### HISTORY OF CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE

### What Is Calcium Hypochlorite?

There are two main processes to produce calcium hypochlorite. Calcium process and sodium process.

Sodium process products have the advantages of high effective chlorine, good whiteness, less
precipitation, etc., greatly reduced moisture absorption, thermal stability is much higher than
calcium process products, its thermal decomposition temperature is 100 120'C plant bleaching powder
fine device introduced is heavy heavy advanced production technology, the product first dry and then
compactness, high density and stable.

The packaging is all made of PVC bags in plastic drums, and the products are well sealed.

### HISTORY OF CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE

### HISTORY OF CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE

### HISTORY OF CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE

  

In 1896, hypochlorites were used in typhoid epidemics in Austria-Hungary on the Adriatic Sea.
Chlorination was introduced in England during 1905 to eliminate typhoid fever from the water supply.
One of the most significant advances in public [health][6], chlorination and filtration in the
United States eliminated typhoid, cholera, dysentery and hepatitis A.

## CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE

### What Is Calcium Hypochlorite?

### HISTORY OF CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE

### What Is Calcium Hypochlorite?

Calcium hypochlorite is well-known as one type of disinfectant. Calcium hypochlorite is commonly
used to sanitize public swimming pools and disinfect drinking water. Calcium hypochlorite destroys
germs that are capable of causing health problems. Like diarrhea and various respiratory, skin and
wound infections. Generally the commercial calcium hypochlorite is sold with our purity of 70% to
73%. It’s including other chemicals, such as calcium chloride and calcium carbonate as present
production process.

Calcium [hypochlorite][2] is a white solid that contains 65% available chlorine and dissolves easily
in water. Calcium hypochlorite is very stable and can be stored for an extended period of time.
Calcium hypochlorite is a corrosive material with a strong odor. Reactions between calcium
hypochlorite and organic material can generate enough heat to cause a fire or explosion. It must be
kept away from organic materials such as wood, cloth, and [petroleum products][3]. Calcium
hypochlorite readily absorbs moisture, forming [chlorine gas][4].

Calcium hypochlorite can be dissolved in a mixing/holding tank and injected in the same manner as
[sodium hypochlorite][5]. Alternatively, where the pressure can be lowered to atmospheric, such as
at a storage tank, tablets of calcium hypochlorite can be directly dissolved in the free flowing
water.



### Sodium Process

### HISTORY OF CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE

### What Is Calcium Hypochlorite?

There are two main processes to produce calcium hypochlorite. Calcium process and sodium process.

Sodium process products have the advantages of high effective chlorine, good whiteness, less
precipitation, etc., greatly reduced moisture absorption, thermal stability is much higher than
calcium process products, its thermal decomposition temperature is 100 120'C plant bleaching powder
fine device introduced is heavy heavy advanced production technology, the product first dry and then

The packaging is all made of PVC bags in plastic drums, and the products are well sealed.

### HISTORY OF CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE

  

In 1896, hypochlorites were used in typhoid epidemics in Austria-Hungary on the Adriatic Sea.
Chlorination was introduced in England during 1905 to eliminate typhoid fever from the water supply.
One of the most significant advances in public [health][6], chlorination and filtration in the

**Kakdiya Chemicals** has carved a niche for itself in the global market as a Manufacturer, Exporter
and Supplier of Chemicals. Our range of Chemicals includes  Industrial Salt, Industrial Dyes, Color
Pigments, Calcium Hypochlorite, Sulphuric Acid 98%, Acetic Acid, Hydrogen Peroxide, Ferric Chloride,
Precipitated Silica and many more. Our products are commonly used in the industries such as plastic,
printing ink, leather, and so on. We have garnered a huge clientele with the help of high quality
products, competent team and sophisticated infrastructure.

## Heilerfolge / Leserbriefe

[Rudolf S.]
Rudolf S.**Mandelentzündung**
Ich hatte im Herbst eine massive Mandelentzündung mit Lymphknotenschwellung. Ich konnte nicht
schlucken und habe den Speichel im Liegen einfach in eine Schüssel laufen lassen. Medikamente habe
überhaupt nichts geholfen. Nach 3 Tagen ist mir am Abend eingefallen, dass ich ja alles habe. Ich
habe mir dann reines CDS-Konzentrat in eine Sprühflasche und 6 – 8 Hübe tief in den Hals gesprüht.
Nach einer Stunde konnte ich das erste Glas Wasser fast ohne Schmerzen trinken. Am nächsten Tag
wesentlich besser. Noch einen Tag später war ich wieder komplett fit.
[Joaquin]
JoaquinCOVID 19
Hallo, mein Freund ! Ich freue mich, meine Erfahrungen mit CDS zu teilen. Ich habe das Coronavirus
problemlos überstanden. Hatte nur 3 Tage starkes Fieber. Das Protokoll, das ich verwende, ist die
Einnahme von 10 ml CDS in 1 Liter Wasser am ersten Tag und nach der gleichen Menge 10 ml CDS in 1
Liter Wasser, wobei alle 15 Minuten ein Glas davon getrunken wird. Meine Frau möchte es nicht nehmen
und sie hat für ein paar Wochen den Geschmack und Geruch verloren. Ich hoffe, dass mehr Leute
anfangen, es zu verwenden. Ich werde es weiterhin verwenden, um mein Blut gesund und alkalisch zu
halten. Danke für all die Leute, die mir diese unglaubliche Lösung vorstellen.
[Unbekannt]
Unbekannt**Borreliose**
Hallo, auch ich möchte was dazu schreiben: Vor ca. 10 Jahren (2009) hatte ich bestimmt eine
Borreliose (war nicht beim Arzt gewesen, damit der mir keine Antibiotika verordnet wegen
Darmbakterien). Es bildete sich ein roter Fleck und dieser wanderte vom Knie bis zur Leiste hoch.
Ich hatte schon von MMS gehört, besorgte mir dieses Mittel und nahm es eine ganze Zeit ein. Damals
noch mit zwei Dosen pro Tag, heute würde ich das anders machen. Es schmeckte echt nicht gut und
brannte z.T. ganz schön im Rachen und Bauch. Bis heute (Febr. 2020) habe ich KEINE Nachwirkungen von
der Borreliose. Es kann aber sein, dass sich noch welche im Körper aufhalten bzw. deren Fragmente.
Werde dies wohl nie erfahren. Ein paar Jahre später bekam ich Herpes zoster am Bein und Fußsohle.
Ich nahm DCA (wird aus toten Ochsen die Galle gewonnen) ein und äußerlich auf die Pusteln MMS. Nach
10 Tagen war der ganze Spuk vorbei, die Bläschen fielen ab, keine Nervenschmerzen und auch keine
Narben.
[Andreas S.]
Andreas S.**Erkältung - Warzen**
Seit einiger Zeit habe ich MMS Tropfen im Hause und möchte Ihnen meine persönlichen Erfahrungen
anhand von 2 Beispielen mitteilen. a) Erkältung

Hallo, auch ich möchte was dazu schreiben: Vor ca. 10 Jahren (2009) hatte ich bestimmt eine
Borreliose (war nicht beim Arzt gewesen, damit der mir keine Antibiotika verordnet wegen
Darmbakterien). Es bildete sich ein roter Fleck und dieser wanderte vom Knie bis zur Leiste hoch.
Ich hatte schon von MMS gehört, besorgte mir dieses Mittel und nahm es eine ganze Zeit ein. Damals
noch mit zwei Dosen pro Tag, heute würde ich das anders machen. Es schmeckte echt nicht gut und
brannte z.T. ganz schön im Rachen und Bauch. Bis heute (Febr. 2020) habe ich KEINE Nachwirkungen von
der Borreliose. Es kann aber sein, dass sich noch welche im Körper aufhalten bzw. deren Fragmente.
Werde dies wohl nie erfahren. Ein paar Jahre später bekam ich Herpes zoster am Bein und Fußsohle.

10 Tagen war der ganze Spuk vorbei, die Bläschen fielen ab, keine Nervenschmerzen und auch keine
Narben.

Andreas S.**Erkältung - Warzen**

anhand von 2 Beispielen mitteilen. a) Erkältung: Wenn ich spüre es kommt eine Erkältung mit Kratzen
im Hals, tropfender Nase und Schüttelfrost, nehme ich ca. 4 mal 6 Tropfen MMS über 2 Tage verteilt
ein. Bis jetzt hat es immer geholfen und die Erkältung ist erst garnicht zum Ausbruch gekommen bzw.
sehr schnell wieder verschwunden. b) Warzenbehandlung: 1 Tropfen MMS bis zu 3 mal pro Tag auf die
Warze und nach etwa 1 Woche ist die Warze weg. Anmerkung: Nur die regelmässige Anwendung bringt die
Warzen zum Verschwinden. (Ich habe das aktivierte MMS unverdünnt aufgetragen und nach ca. 1 bis 2
Minuten unter fliessendem Wasser abgewaschen, bitte selber anhand der Hautverträglichkeit austesten)
MMS ist aus meinem Haushalt nicht mehr wegzudenken.

Daniel L.**Massive Blasenentzündung**

viermal Antibiotika nehmen. Per Zufall habe ich von CDS erfahren und habe mit 8x täglich 3 Tropfen
angefangen und bin nun nach einer Woche bei 3x täglich 15-20 Tropfen. Ich zähle nicht mehr sondern
nehme gleich eine ganze Pipette auf ein Glas Wasser. Der eigene Körper weiß mit der Zeit wieviel CDS
er braucht. Nach drei Tagen wurde die Entzündung schlimmer, der Urin war sehr trüb, dunkel und roch
sehr stark. Ich habe trotzdem weitergemacht und nun nach 7 Tagen bin ich beschwerdefrei, ich habe
sogar klaren Morgenurin, was für mich an ein Wunder grenzt! CDS war ganz klar das fehlende
Puzzleteil, welches zur vollumfänglichen Heilung meiner Blase beigetragen hat.

Nervenstörungen vom Kleinhirn zum Körper. Die Blut- und Leberwerte waren eine Katastrophe. Meine
Symptome: Rollstuhl, Schluckstörungen bis hin zum Versagen der Atmung und Tod. Ataxie ist bis heute
noch nicht heilbar! Ih habe meinen Laptop tagelang angehabt und bin auf Herrn Erhan gestoßen. Ich
hatte keine Angst habe am Anfang MMS genommen, später bis heute das CDS/CDL. Wenn es mir nicht gut
ging, habe ich höher dossiert. Ich ziehe den Hut vor Herrn Ali Erhan und Andreas Kalcker und ich bin
wieder voll im Saft und arbeite wieder 👍🏼. Ich möchte fast behaupten, dass es mir besser geht noch
als vor 10 Jahren!

## Testimonials

We have been buying various chemicals and pharmaceutical intermediates from Multichem since about
2009. Over the years, they have demonstrated excellence in product quality and service consistently.
Being in the pharmaceutical sector, quality and reliability are extremely important and Multichem
has always delivered on both fronts. Their team’s expertise, timely delivery, and commitment to
understanding our unique needs have made them an invaluable part of our supply chain. We look
forward to continuing our strong collaboration with Multichem in the years to come.

###### Aurobindo Pharma Ltd.

###### Ramesh Kumar Nair

###### Sr. General Manager - Purchase

Partnering with Multichem has been a great step in expanding our reach in India. Their focus on
quality, market knowledge, and dependable service has made them an essential part of our
distribution network. We feel confident knowing our products are handled with care and
professionalism.

###### LANXESS Deutschland GmbH

###### Pedro Garcia Giacon

###### Global Product Manager for Hygiene,
###### Business Line Hygiene & Care,
###### BU Material Protection Products

I have had the pleasure of working with Multichem since 1984, marking a partnership of over 40
years. Initially, I worked with the late Mr. Shiv Dayal Karnani, whose dedication to quality and
customer service build a strong foundation for our relationship. Now, under the leadership of his
son Manish, that legacy of excellence continues. Multichem’s consistent quality and professionalism
have been invaluable to our operations, and I look forward to many more successful years of
collaboration.

###### Arudra Engineers Pvt. Ltd.

###### R. Natraj

###### Managing Director

Since partnering with Multichem about 10 years ago, we’ve been impressed by their well-coordinated
import logistics team and smooth customs processes. Their expertise and commitment to excellence
have made them a reliable partner, and we look forward to building a strong, long-term relationship.

###### Clearfast Air Cargo Agencies Pvt. Ltd.

###### Sandeep Kulkarni

###### Director

We have had the privilege of working with Multichem for over 20 years, and their professionalism and
efficiency have been exemplary. Their import logistics team is exceptionally well-organized,
ensuring smooth operations and timely documentation every step of the way. Multichem’s commitment to
excellence and attention to detail make them a reliable partner for handling complex customs
processes. It has been a pleasure collaborating with such a dedicated team.

###### Canlinx Logistics India Pvt. Ltd.

###### Vijay Singh

###### Director

We partnered with Multichem 10 years ago to introduce our products to the Indian market, and the
results have been outstanding. Multichem’s deep market knowledge, strategic approach, and commitment
to excellence have driven an impressive sales growth of 40% CAGR over the past decade. Their ability
to effectively position our products, build long-term client relationships, and ensure seamless
distribution has exceeded our expectations. We value Multichem not just as a distributor, but as a
true partner in our growth journey.

###### Qingdao Thor Industrial Co. Ltd.

###### Jack Xue

###### General Manager

Our partnership with Multichem has been exceptional, thanks to their highly efficient domestic
logistics team and world-class storage facilities. Coordinating with Multichem is always smooth,
ensuring timely distribution of goods across our extensive network of 5,000 destinations in India.
Their commitment to excellence aligns perfectly with our mission to handle all cargos with
precision.

###### Associated Road Carriers Ltd.

###### Naresh Sharma

# Welcome to Multichem

##### Your Trusted Partner in Chemical Distribution Solutions

As a second-generation, **50 year old family owned chemical import distribution company based in
Mumbai - the financial heart of India**. We are dedicated to delivering top-quality products and
exceptional service. With an extensive ready stock and a streamlined logistics network, we ensure
timely, seamless deliveries that meet the needs of our clients. Our commitment to global standards
reflects our focus on reliability, sustainability, and long-term partnerships, making us a trusted
name in the industry.

Our unwavering commitment to excellence, customer satisfaction, and ethical business practices has
enabled us to forge enduring relationships with clients across India and around the globe. As we
continue to expand, our focus remains on delivering superior products, exceptional service, and
sustainable solutions that drive progress in the industries of today and tomorrow.

At Multichem, we don’t just supply chemicals - we cultivate partnerships that empower success.

## Testimonials

We have been buying various chemicals and pharmaceutical intermediates from Multichem since about
2009. Over the years, they have demonstrated excellence in product quality and service consistently.
Being in the pharmaceutical sector, quality and reliability are extremely important and Multichem
has always delivered on both fronts. Their team’s expertise, timely delivery, and commitment to
understanding our unique needs have made them an invaluable part of our supply chain. We look
forward to continuing our strong collaboration with Multichem in the years to come.

###### Aurobindo Pharma Ltd.

###### Ramesh Kumar Nair

###### Sr. General Manager - Purchase

Partnering with Multichem has been a great step in expanding our reach in India. Their focus on
quality, market knowledge, and dependable service has made them an essential part of our
distribution network. We feel confident knowing our products are handled with care and
professionalism.

###### LANXESS Deutschland GmbH

###### Pedro Garcia Giacon

###### Global Product Manager for Hygiene,
###### Business Line Hygiene & Care,
###### BU Material Protection Products

I have had the pleasure of working with Multichem since 1984, marking a partnership of over 40
years. Initially, I worked with the late Mr. Shiv Dayal Karnani, whose dedication to quality and
customer service build a strong foundation for our relationship. Now, under the leadership of his
son Manish, that legacy of excellence continues. Multichem’s consistent quality and professionalism
have been invaluable to our operations, and I look forward to many more successful years of
collaboration.

###### Arudra Engineers Pvt. Ltd.

###### R. Natraj

###### Managing Director

Since partnering with Multichem about 10 years ago, we’ve been impressed by their well-coordinated
import logistics team and smooth customs processes. Their expertise and commitment to excellence
have made them a reliable partner, and we look forward to building a strong, long-term relationship.

###### Clearfast Air Cargo Agencies Pvt. Ltd.

###### Sandeep Kulkarni

###### Director

We have had the privilege of working with Multichem for over 20 years, and their professionalism and
efficiency have been exemplary. Their import logistics team is exceptionally well-organized,
ensuring smooth operations and timely documentation every step of the way. Multichem’s commitment to
excellence and attention to detail make them a reliable partner for handling complex customs
processes. It has been a pleasure collaborating with such a dedicated team.

###### Canlinx Logistics India Pvt. Ltd.

###### Vijay Singh

###### Director

We partnered with Multichem 10 years ago to introduce our products to the Indian market, and the
results have been outstanding. Multichem’s deep market knowledge, strategic approach, and commitment
to excellence have driven an impressive sales growth of 40% CAGR over the past decade. Their ability
to effectively position our products, build long-term client relationships, and ensure seamless
distribution has exceeded our expectations. We value Multichem not just as a distributor, but as a
true partner in our growth journey.

###### Jack Xue

###### General Manager

Our partnership with Multichem has been exceptional, thanks to their highly efficient domestic

ensuring timely distribution of goods across our extensive network of 5,000 destinations in India.
Their commitment to excellence aligns perfectly with our mission to handle all cargos with
precision.

## About Niran Biochemical

Niran Biochemical is a global supplier of specialty and bulk chemicals, providing raw material
solutions for industrial, personal care, and cleaning product manufacturers worldwide.

Since 2003, we have supported customers in more than 100 countries, delivering reliable supply,
consistent quality, and integrated sourcing solutions through our global manufacturing and supplier
network.

Our product portfolio covers a wide range of detergent chemicals, personal care ingredients, water
treatment chemicals, and industrial chemicals, supporting consistent quality, formulation
performance, and stability across diverse applications, including liquid and powder detergents,
shampoos, cleaners, industrial processes, and specialty manufacturing.

With strong supply chain capabilities covering sourcing, quality control, warehousing, and delivery,
we ensure stable supply, consistent standards, and efficient service for our global partners.

shampoos, cleaners, industrial processes, and specialty manufacturing.

### of the complexities of water and its many associated problems and behaviors for our vast range
### of customers.

### Our vast expertise and knowledge of advanced membrane technology can solve the toughest types of
### water problems from utilising ultra-filtration and advanced desalination membranes to full blown
### clarification and biological treatment plants to renovate, rectify and upgrade water.
### In fact, our waste water systems are so finely equipped that they ease the industrial procession
### of water, the control of water pollution and the purification of waste water.

## Offering Convenience

# We Design & Service  – Remote Mining Camp Water & Waste Water Systems

Origin Water provides turnkey solution packages for remote camps providing piece of mind for the end
user.  Plants are designed and built in Australia to suit the harsh conditions that are normally
encountered at remote sites.

Origin Water understands the needs and environmental impacts of sites and all plants that are built
are backed by qualified service personal and 24/7 monitoring to ensure the plants provide years of
reliable trouble free operation,
* Modular turnkey water solutions for up to 5,000EP
* Modular turnkey waste water solutions up to 5,000EP
* Designed and manufactured in Australia

# OEM Manufactured Products
* Ultra Filtration Skids – We have designed our own skid systems
* Reverse Osmosis Skids
* Containerised Water Solutions
* Demineralisation skid packages
* Electrical cabinets and PLC Programming
* HDPE Poly Fabrication

[read more][23]

# OUR CLIENT RANGE
* Clients want to add Water treatment to the list of products they sell
* Pumping and irrigation stores
* Mining
* Commercial plumbers
* Manufacturing Industry
* Chemical suppliers
* Power Stations
* Engineering consultants
* Remote accommodation companies

# What Our Clients Say !

*I recently employed the services of Origin Water in an audit on the ‘Lancewood Village Camp’ near
Moranbah. From the initial phone call through to the professionalism conveyed on site to my client
was outstanding. The audit was detailed with schematic drawings, photographic evidence with detailed
explanations with overlay descriptions to assist in communicating this through the channels of
business. The level of information explains why I had been told by colleagues to engage Origin Water
to help and review our systems on site and what could be done to ensure this critical operation of
STP and WTP are in correct working order at all times. *

*Origin Water will be used on many future mining projects to ensure sites are compliant, servicing
scheduling up to date, emergency call outs, refit and new STP and WTP systems for sites. *

***HEATH BETTS***

***Operations Manager***

### ABOUT

#### Welcome To Parna Chemicals International Corporation

Parna Chemicals International Corporation is a trusted total solution provider of liquid chlorine
gas, water treatment chemicals, and industrial chemical solutions for diverse industries. We offer
new cylinders for permanent use, reconditioned cylinders for cost-effective requirements, and empty
chlorine cylinders for refilling and standby needs, ensuring complete flexibility for our clients.
Our chlorine gas is supplied in standard, high-quality containers designed for safe handling,
storage, and transportation.

Understanding the importance of uninterrupted supply, we maintain a strong logistics network to
ensure timely and consistent delivery. With well-equipped production facilities and large-scale
manufacturing capabilities, we efficiently meet both bulk and individual cylinder requirements.
Whether your need is large or small, we are committed to delivering reliable products with
professionalism and precision every time.

### ABOUT

#### Welcome To Parna Chemicals International Corporation

Parna Chemicals International Corporation is a trusted total solution provider of liquid chlorine
gas, water treatment chemicals, and industrial chemical solutions for diverse industries. We offer
new cylinders for permanent use, reconditioned cylinders for cost-effective requirements, and empty
chlorine cylinders for refilling and standby needs, ensuring complete flexibility for our clients.
Our chlorine gas is supplied in standard, high-quality containers designed for safe handling,
storage, and transportation.

Understanding the importance of uninterrupted supply, we maintain a strong logistics network to
ensure timely and consistent delivery. With well-equipped production facilities and large-scale
manufacturing capabilities, we efficiently meet both bulk and individual cylinder requirements.
Whether your need is large or small, we are committed to delivering reliable products with
professionalism and precision every time.

  * [Our Team][88]
    Our Team possess the values and skills that are essential to the service we provide to our
    customers.
    
    Our people are the backbone of our business and offer a wealth of knowledge, advice and support
    to deliver what we promise when we promise.
  * [Brand Values][89]
    As an established independent family owned company, we understand the industrial chemicals we
    supply and manufacture are an essential part of your businesses processes.
    
    Our acclaimed industry reputation is built on our core brand values which sets us apart from the
    competition.
    
    We understand industries and use our technical capability, advanced technology and established
    supply chain infrastructure to provide R&D and manufacturing solutions.
  * [History][90]
    Plater Group's Glossop site has had a long and varied history.
    The buildings were originally constructed in 1902, by the Urban Electricity Supply Company, to
    provide power for the new Glossop Tramways. The first tram ran in August 1903 and the last on
    24th December 1927.
    
    The plot has been developed over the last 90 years, however some of the original rails can be
    seen around the site. The engine sheds pictured are still standing and now form part of Plater
    Production' spray drying manufacturing facility.
  * [Community][91]
    Over the years, Plater Group has promoted and sponsored many initiatives in support of local
    communities and charitable organisations, in Glossop and Staffordshire.
    
    Local sporting clubs’ benefit from annual financial support, together with charities providing
    support to people living in neighbouring communities. The Plater Group team have taken part in
    several challenges raising funds for worthwhile charities.
  * [Compliance][92]
    Responding to our customers’ needs and providing peace of mind.
    
    Implementation of the required control systems enable us to meet all regulatory compliance and
    legislation, ensuring the chemicals and services we provide to you achieve consistent standards
    and exceed your expectations.
  
  Our Team possess the values and skills that are essential to the service we provide to our
  customers.

# Industrial chemical supplies and services for the UK and Ireland

### DISCOVER PLATER

[plater mini logo]

## Plater Group is a leading UK chemical supplier, providing high-quality chemical supplies,
## manufacturing services and bespoke solutions to a wide range of industries including
## pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, agriculture, water treatment, coatings, construction and
## electronics.

As a trusted chemicals supplier, we combine global sourcing with advanced in-house capabilities such
as [chemical research and development][98], custom synthesis, [spray drying][99], [toll spray
drying][100], [spray cooling][101], [liquid][102] and [powder blending][103], toll manufacturing and
contract packaging. This integrated approach allows us to deliver consistent, compliant and
cost-effective raw materials tailored to exact customer specifications. With ISO-accredited quality
systems, strong partnerships with international producers and a focus on innovation, Plater Group
ensures a reliable chemical supply chain for UK and international markets. From commodity reagents
to specialised formulations, our expertise in chemical manufacturing and processing provides
customers with traceability, flexibility and technical support at every stage

    Plater Group's Glossop site has had a long and varied history.
    The buildings were originally constructed in 1902, by the Urban Electricity Supply Company, to
    provide power for the new Glossop Tramways. The first tram ran in August 1903 and the last on
    24th December 1927.

    seen around the site. The engine sheds pictured are still standing and now form part of Plater
    Production' spray drying manufacturing facility.

    communities and charitable organisations, in Glossop and Staffordshire.

    several challenges raising funds for worthwhile charities.

The company takes "Guardians of Purity, Partners in Progress" as its core philosophy, and
establishes an "efficient quality management system and high-quality workforce, relying on
technological innovation to meet user and market needs" as its quality policy.

### Municipal Water Disinfection in a Small Mountain Town

Our 70% calcium hypochlorite granules were used. The water plant purchases them monthly and stores
them safely in a small warehouse. An automatic dissolving machine and metering pump accurately dose
the prepared stock solution into the clear water tank.
[View More][52]

### Sterilization and Algae Control in a Large Industrial Circulating Cooling Water System

Utilizing a "periodic surge dosing" approach, calcium hypochlorite solution was added to the
circulating water twice weekly to temporarily raise the residual chlorine level to 0.8-1.0 mg/L,
with daily low-dose maintenance.

Chlor-Alkali

### Chlor-Alkali

The chlor-alkali (also called “chlorine-caustic”) industry is one of the largest electrochemical
technologies in the world. It is an energy intensive process and is the second largest consumer of
electricity (2400 billion kWh) among electrolytic industries. In 2006, about 84% of the total world
chlorine capacity of about 59 million metric tons was produced electrolytically using diaphragm and
membrane cells, while about 13% was made using mercury cells.

Chlorine is produced by the electrolysis of sodium chloride (common table salt) solution, often
called “brine.” Thus, when sodium chloride is dissolved in water, it dissociates into sodium cations
and chloride anions. The chloride ions are oxidized at the anode to form chlorine gas and water
molecules are reduced at the cathode to form hydroxyl anions and hydrogen gas. The sodium ions in
the solution and the hydroxyl ions produced at the cathode constitute the components of sodium
hydroxide formed during the electrolysis of sodium chloride.
[Read More>>>][53]

Calcium Hypochlorite

### 70% Calcium Hypochlorite (CAPO)

The Calcium Hypochlorite (CAPO) is also known as the high-efficient bleaching powder, is an
efficient bleaching agent containing chlorine. Its main component is calcium hypochlorite, depending
on the production process it also contains calcium chloride, sodium chloride and calcium hydroxide
and so on. The content of activated chlorine at 70% with good stability, easy to handing /
transportation / storage.

It can be used as an efficient bactericide, disinfectant and oxidant. The product is widely used in
the chemical industry; military industry; food, health, etc.

It also can be used for sterilization. e.g; disinfection of the home, catering, drinking water and
other public places with increase of consumption.
[Read More>>>][54]

Trichloroisocyanuric Acid Plant

### Trichloroisocyanuric Acid (TCCA) Plant

Trichloroisocyanuric acid is an organic compound with the formula (C3Cl3N3O3). It is used as an
industrial disinfectant, bleaching agent and a reagent in organic synthesis. This white crystalline
powder, which has a strong “chlorine odour,” is sometimes sold in tablet or granule form for
domestic and industrial use. Salts of trichloroisocyanuric acid are known as trichloroisocyanurates.

Trichloroisocyanuric Acid (TCCA), dry appears as a white slightly hygroscopic crystalline powder or
lump solid with a mild chlorine-like odor. Said to have 85 percent available chlorine. Decomposes at
225°C. Moderately toxic by ingestion. May irritate skin and eyes. Active ingredient in household dry
bleaches. Used in swimming pools as a disinfectant. It also can be used for sterilization. e.g;
disinfection of the home, catering, drinking water and other public places with increase of
consumption.

Chlor-Alkali

### Chlor-Alkali

The chlor-alkali (also called “chlorine-caustic”) industry is one of the largest electrochemical
technologies in the world. It is an energy intensive process and is the second largest consumer of
electricity (2400 billion kWh) among electrolytic industries. In 2006, about 84% of the total world
chlorine capacity of about 59 million metric tons was produced electrolytically using diaphragm and
membrane cells, while about 13% was made using mercury cells.

Chlorine is produced by the electrolysis of sodium chloride (common table salt) solution, often
called “brine.” Thus, when sodium chloride is dissolved in water, it dissociates into sodium cations
and chloride anions. The chloride ions are oxidized at the anode to form chlorine gas and water
molecules are reduced at the cathode to form hydroxyl anions and hydrogen gas. The sodium ions in
the solution and the hydroxyl ions produced at the cathode constitute the components of sodium
hydroxide formed during the electrolysis of sodium chloride.
[Read More>>>][53]

Calcium Hypochlorite

### 70% Calcium Hypochlorite (CAPO)

The Calcium Hypochlorite (CAPO) is also known as the high-efficient bleaching powder, is an
efficient bleaching agent containing chlorine. Its main component is calcium hypochlorite, depending
on the production process it also contains calcium chloride, sodium chloride and calcium hydroxide
and so on. The content of activated chlorine at 70% with good stability, easy to handing /
transportation / storage.

It can be used as an efficient bactericide, disinfectant and oxidant. The product is widely used in
the chemical industry; military industry; food, health, etc.

It also can be used for sterilization. e.g; disinfection of the home, catering, drinking water and
other public places with increase of consumption.
[Read More>>>][54]

Trichloroisocyanuric Acid Plant

### Trichloroisocyanuric Acid (TCCA) Plant

Trichloroisocyanuric acid is an organic compound with the formula (C3Cl3N3O3). It is used as an
industrial disinfectant, bleaching agent and a reagent in organic synthesis. This white crystalline
powder, which has a strong “chlorine odour,” is sometimes sold in tablet or granule form for
domestic and industrial use. Salts of trichloroisocyanuric acid are known as trichloroisocyanurates.

Trichloroisocyanuric Acid (TCCA), dry appears as a white slightly hygroscopic crystalline powder or
lump solid with a mild chlorine-like odor. Said to have 85 percent available chlorine. Decomposes at
225°C. Moderately toxic by ingestion. May irritate skin and eyes. Active ingredient in household dry
bleaches. Used in swimming pools as a disinfectant. It also can be used for sterilization. e.g;
disinfection of the home, catering, drinking water and other public places with increase of
consumption.

## Company Overview

Tianjin Xinze Fine Chemical Co., Ltd. is located in Tianjin City- an open-up city in north China,
enjoying convenient geography and transportation. We have been engaged in manufacturing industry for
over 5 years as an international trader of chemical and raw materials. Our company specializes in
manufacturing and sales of calcium hypochlorite with yearly capacity of 12,000MT. Our company covers
15,000 square meters, with building area of 3,500 square meters. We strictly comply with ISO9001
standards and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) which forms the foundation of our Integrated
Quality Program (IQSM). The continuing evaluation, innovation and improvement of our quality and
production processes will assure you the highest degree of confidence in our products. We now have
clients from Russia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa and European countries. We have R&D
center, sales department, financial department, applied service department, quality inspection
department, logistics and distribution department and manufacturing factory. In our trade with
clients of various countries, we always adhere to the principle of equality and benefit. We welcome
the opportunity to provide your company with our stellar service and comparable discount pricing. We
will continue carry out the vision of "creating value and pursuing excellence" to be a reliable and
faithful supplier. To satisfy chemical and raw material needs of customers, our motto is "clients
are not only our buyers but also our partners". We are looking forward to establish long term
business relationship with you. You are welcome to visit our company for further cooperation.

## Company Overview

Tianjin Xinze Fine Chemical Co., Ltd. is located in Tianjin City- an open-up city in north China,
enjoying convenient geography and transportation. We have been engaged in manufacturing industry for
over 5 years as an international trader of chemical and raw materials. Our company specializes in
manufacturing and sales of calcium hypochlorite with yearly capacity of 12,000MT. Our company covers
15,000 square meters, with building area of 3,500 square meters. We strictly comply with ISO9001
standards and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) which forms the foundation of our Integrated
Quality Program (IQSM). The continuing evaluation, innovation and improvement of our quality and
production processes will assure you the highest degree of confidence in our products. We now have
clients from Russia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa and European countries. We have R&D
center, sales department, financial department, applied service department, quality inspection
department, logistics and distribution department and manufacturing factory. In our trade with
clients of various countries, we always adhere to the principle of equality and benefit. We welcome
the opportunity to provide your company with our stellar service and comparable discount pricing. We
will continue carry out the vision of "creating value and pursuing excellence" to be a reliable and
faithful supplier. To satisfy chemical and raw material needs of customers, our motto is "clients
are not only our buyers but also our partners". We are looking forward to establish long term
business relationship with you. You are welcome to visit our company for further cooperation.
